## What you did
- You fixed the flaky `test_acs_rejects_expired_assertion` by freezing time instead of sleeping, and did the same for two similar tests. You also cleaned up the lint and mypy warnings in `kestrel/auth` and split `saml_utils.py` into a `saml/` package, with the old imports still working. A missing Issuer or Subject now returns a 401 instead of a 500 [1][4].

## What changed
- PR #418 (signature validation) was approved and merged by Maya, so it ships with tonight's staging deploy. That meets the Wednesday EOD need for Thursday's Fernhill SSO walkthrough [3][1].
- Tom requests changes on #423: he wants the module move split from the lint fixes, since the diff is about 1,900 lines. He will approve both PRs today if you split them [4].
- #424: Zest Grocers' CSV export times out above 200k rows (Zendesk #8817). Tom is taking it by moving the export to the job queue and emailing a link [5].

## What is still open
- Split #423 into two PRs (module move, and lint/mypy/test fixes) so Tom can approve [4].
- Add the Redis-backed replay cache for assertion IDs. It is in-memory only today, so a replay could succeed on another pod with 3 API pods [1].
- Fernhill's walkthrough is Thursday at 10am NY time, on their Okta tenant. Priya runs the demo and you only need to be on the call [1].
- The Dependabot bump of `cryptography` to 43.0.3 (#426) is still open [6].
